page.overview:
What is G30 racing starfighter?

The G30 racing starfighter was a type of racing ship manufactured by Incom-Freitek. The starfighter's S-foils could be adjusted for better aim of the wingtip-mounted Taim & Bak KX10B laser cannons or to accommodate the need for speed or maneuverability.
